title: Coast Guard Search and Rescue Case
description:
Story about a search and rescue case in Micronesia during a Coast Guard exercise there.  The Coast Guard was on hand to assist, and used research from oceanographers participating in the exercise to help find a lost Micronesian boat.

Available in High Definition.
